interpretation.acceptance: Build/integrity results do not establish owner functional acceptance or permission to promote trimming.
interpretation.actualFileInventories: Captured post-link prebundle inputs plus final loose distribution files. Their asset counts are distinct from .deps entries.
interpretation.launch: Fresh/cached --version artifact probes only; agent initialization, gateway readiness and RSS not measured.
interpretation.publishedRuntimeGraph: Exact final prebundle .deps graph, retaining dependency-only nodes and distinguishing packages/runtimepacks/first-party projects.
interpretation.restoredClosure: Per-RID restored target; package presence here does not mean a shipped runtime asset.
interpretation.warningCounts: Metrics warningsByCode counts raw log occurrences, including repeated MSBuild summaries; full warnings/logs preserve call sites.
